text: Entry 1486 introduces shortcut-row with a light-DOM template and a connected-once guard. The accepted class still only appends that template, and the template displays the constant Alt + 1 text. The container and packaging establish ownership but do not implement shortcut capture, remapping or persistence. Preserve this incomplete-feature boundary when reviewing the initial component; no actual rebinding or keyboard conflict handling is proved. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source adoption does not establish reviewer approval.
title: Shortcut-row is still a component scaffold with a placeholder binding
